info.title: sentin8-ai
info.description: Sentin8 Sentin8:AI - platform AI capability layer.

get.summary:
`GET /v1/admin/{resource}` - RFW data endpoint (env-scoped, RLS on the
same connection; `target_env_id` REQUIRED - Fix A).

post.summary:
`POST /v1/agent/execute` - controlled agent execution. The model
emits intent only; this endpoint maps an allowed intent to a
Sentin8:Flow workflow whose domain steps proxy-back to the owning
service. `requires_confirmation` intents pause in a ManualDecisionStep.

403.description: Action not in the prompt's tool allowlist

422.description: Model output is not a valid intent

put.summary: `PUT /v1/agents/{name}` - create or update an agent and its tool set.

post.summary: `POST /v1/approvals/{id}/decide` - approve or deny a paused action.

`POST /v1/chat` - chat inference through the prompt registry + provider
router. Idempotency-Key honored; trace emitted.

`POST /v1/chat/stream` - streaming chat over a chunked HTTP body
. NOT the SSE subscription tier - synchronous inference streams
 the response body directly (transport-tier rule).
 Content is emitted as newline-delimited JSON chunks; the final chunk
 carries the token accounting.

`POST /v1/completions` - completion inference. Same pipeline as
chat; the action scope differs.
`POST /v1/conversations` - open a conversation bound to an agent.

post.description:
The loop: assemble context → provider → tool calls (gateway) → tool
results → provider, until the model stops or a guard trips. Every guard
is recorded on the run; every message commits with the run update.

get.summary:
`GET /v1/costs` - per-feature/model spend rollup for the env,
reading the AI's own trace aggregates (Stat cross-service rollup lands
with the Dash integration).

post.summary:
`POST /v1/dlq/{id}/replay` - re-enqueue a dead-lettered job (cron
republish pattern: re-insert the pending job, delete the DLQ row, emit
the republished event inbox-first).

`POST /v1/documents/ingest` - chunk → embed → store (/).
Chunk text lives in Sentin8:Storage (object per chunk under the document
key), vectors + metadata in `ai.embeddings` with source refs.
RLS env match + the caller's data_scope on chunk metadata.
`POST /v1/embeddings` - batch embedding via the provider router.

`POST /v1/evaluations/run` - score a prompt version against a golden set
. Each case runs a synchronous inference and checks the
 expectation; the aggregate score lands in `ai.evaluations`.

put.summary:
`PUT /v1/filters/{name}` - create/update an env safety filter rule
. The baseline prompt-injection rule is code and unaffected.

delete.summary:
`DELETE /v1/filters/{name}` - remove an env filter rule. The baseline
injection rule is code and cannot be removed.

204.description: Filter rule removed (same contract as DELETE /v1/filters/{name})

get.summary: `GET /v1/health` - service health (custom payload; shell health suppressed).

post.summary:
`POST /v1/internal/agent/execute` - the domain-step surface Sentin8:Flow
proxy-backs to for a legacy JSON-intent agent workflow (ai DESIGN.md
§4.1). The step's `step_config` names a tool; the gateway dispatches it
under the workflow's env with the `ai-proxy` workload identity.

`POST /v1/internal/schedules/run` - Sentin8:Cron proxy-back target
. Runs stale-index maintenance: re-enqueue embedding jobs for
 sources whose embedding is older than the freshness window. Authenticated
 by the cron ticker's M2M token (verified the same way as user tokens -
 `token_tp: m2m` principals evaluate like any other under Shield).

`POST /v1/internal/traces/archive` - age out hot traces older than the
per-env retention window to Sentin8:Storage (Stat pattern). Called by the
cron proxy-back (`/v1/internal/schedules/run` maintenance) - never by
clients directly.
`POST /v1/prompts` - create a new prompt version (immutable per version).

delete.summary:
`DELETE /v1/prompts/{name}/{version}` - retire a version (never hard-delete
platform history; tenant rows may be removed).

put.summary: `PUT /v1/providers/{provider}` - upsert a provider config (secret ref only).

`PUT /v1/embedding-registry/{model}` - pin a model→dimension mapping for
the env. Mismatched embeddings are rejected with 422.

post.summary:
`POST /v1/retrieval` - hybrid retrieval: vector similarity (pgvector) +
keyword (tsvector, when pgvector is absent) + metadata filters +
permission filter from the caller's `data_scope`. Standard RLS env_id
match is the backstop; the data_scope filter is defense-in-depth.

put.summary: `PUT /v1/tools/{name}` - create or update a tenant tool.

AgentIntent.description:
Structured intent emitted by the model. The model has NO
execution surface - this contract is the only output shape accepted.

callback_base_url.description: Flow callback base URL override (defaults to this service's URL).

prompt_name.description:
Prompt registry name - its `tools` array is the ALLOWLIST of actions
the model may emit (mapped to Flow logics via `sentin8.ai_tools`).

task.description: The user's task (merged with the prompt's system text).

intent.description: The structured intent the model produced.

workflow_id.description:
None = intent requires confirmation and the Flow workflow is waiting
in a ManualDecisionStep. Some(id) = workflow created.

content.description: Text content. Empty on an assistant turn that only calls tools.

tool_call_id.description: Links a `role: "tool"` message to the call it answers.

tool_calls.description: Tool calls an assistant message requested.

agent_name.description:
Agent name to bind. Required - a conversation without an agent has no
prompt, no tools, and no policy.

data_scope.description:
Caller's data scope attached to the chunks' metadata (retrieval
permission filter).

storage_key.description: Sentin8:Storage object key holding the document text.

text.description:
Already-extracted text (extract step happens upstream or in this
request - v1 accepts the plain text; PDF extraction is a Func WASM
module concern).

feature.description: Feature label for cost attribution `{env_id, feature, model}`.

messages.description: Inline messages (chat) - merged after the prompt's system/user text.

prompt_name.description:
Prompt registry name - config (models, temperature, schema) resolves
from the named-latest/pinned version unless overridden inline.

PolicySetDetail.description: One policy set in the detail view (adds the full policy text).

enabled.description: Whether the set participates in evaluation.

policies.description: The full policy text (Shield policy language).

schema.description: Optional schema text bound to the set.

mode.description: The evaluation mode after the mutation.

PolicySetRow.description: One policy set in the list view (the RFW row shape).

enabled.description: Whether the set participates in evaluation.

id.description: The set name; doubles as the RFW row id.

policies_len.description: Number of policy statements in the set.

PolicyTestOutcome.description: A dry-run (test) outcome; nothing was stored.

policy_set_name.description: The set name the candidate text was compiled under.

would_deny.description: Whether the shadow evaluation would deny.

text.description: The user's message for this turn.

turn_id.description:
Client-supplied turn id - a retried turn returns the stored answer
instead of appending a duplicate.

PrincipalAttr.description: One principal attribute in the list view.

attr_value.description: The attribute value (free-form JSON by contract).

RelationRecordRow.description: One relation tuple in the list view.

data_scope.description:
Caller's Shield-resolved data scope - applied as an explicit metadata
filter IN THE QUERY (the LLM never sees out-of-scope chunks).

metadata_filters.description:
Metadata filters: `{"key": "value",. }` - each becomes
`metadata->'key' == value` in the SQL (AND-composed).

rerank_model.description:
When the prompt config declares a reranker model (`openai/rerank-x`),
the vector/keyword union is re-scored by it before returning.

env_id.description: The env to sweep (absent = whole registry).

StaleEmbedding.description: One stale embedding in the maintenance report.

TargetEnvQuery.description:
Query params accepted by all env-scoped endpoints. `target_env_id` is
forwarded by the BFF proxy to identify the tenant env when the caller's
token carries the system env ( Fix A/D - REQUIRED, no
silent fallback).

roles.description: Sample live-role names for role-based candidate rules.

ToolCall.description:
A tool call a model emitted, normalised across providers.

OpenAI-family providers carry `arguments` as a JSON *string*; Anthropic
carries an already-decoded object. Both converge here as a parsed
[`serde_json::Value`] so the turn runner never handles provider wire
shapes.

id.description: Provider-assigned call id (echoed back on the tool-result message).

name.description: Tool name - resolved against `ai.tools` by the gateway.

env_id.description: The env whose traces are archived.

archived.description: Rows moved to Storage (0 on a retained run).

storage_key.description: The NDJSON object key (successful run only).

approval_id.description: Set when the turn paused for approval.

tools.description: Tool names to bind. Unknown names are rejected (fail-closed).

origin.description: `platform` rows are overwritten by enroll; `tenant` rows never are.

version.description: Explicit version; omit = next version for the name.

credential_ref.description: Secret reference - NEVER the credential material itself.
